summary: The Independent's timeline traces Britney Spears and Kevin Federline's relationship from their 2004 meeting and marriage through divorce, custody and child support disputes, her conservatorship, and public clashes in 2022. It is framed around the upcoming release of Spears's memoir, The Woman in Me, on 24 October. The piece covers how the former couple continue to navigate co-parenting their two teenage sons.
one_line: A timeline of Britney Spears and Kevin Federline's relationship, from their 2004 marriage through divorce, custody battles and 2022 public disputes, ahead of her memoir.
key_facts: Britney Spears and Kevin Federline began dating in 2004, when Federline was a backup dancer for Justin Timberlake; he said they met at a Hollywood club called Joseph's.
After three months of dating, they married in September 2004 in a surprise ceremony in Studio City, California; Federline was 26 and Spears 22.
Earlier in 2004, Spears had married childhood friend Jason Alexander, but the marriage was annulled after 55 hours.
Their sons are Sean Preston, born weeks before their first anniversary, and Jayden James, born in 2006.
Spears filed for divorce in November 2006, eight weeks after Jayden's birth, citing 'irreconcilable differences'; the settlement was finalised in July 2007 with joint legal and physical custody.
After Spears's 2008 breakdown and 5150 psychiatric hold, Federline kept sole custody; in February 2008 her father Jamie Spears took control of her assets under a conservatorship.
In 2018 Federline sought $20,000 more per month in child support, then doubled his request to $40k; a September 2018 settlement raised Spears's payments from $20,000 to $35,000 a month.
In 2019 Federline was granted 70 percent custodial rights and Spears 30 percent.
Spears's 13-year conservatorship ended in November 2021, following her June 2021 testimony in which she called for those involved to be 'put in jail'.
Spears married Sam Asghari in June 2022 at their Los Angeles home; her sons and parents did not attend, and Asghari filed for divorce in August 2023 after 14 months.
In August 2022 Federline told ITV the boys found it 'tough' seeing their mother share nude photos online; Spears called the comments 'HURTFUL' on Instagram Stories.
Spears's attorney Mathew Rosengart said Federline's posting of a private video of the children created 'legal issues' including possible cyber-harassment and cyber-bullying statutes.
Federline has two daughters with wife Victoria Prince, Jordan Kay, 12, and Peyton Marie, nine, and previously had Kori Madison and Kaleb Michael with Shar Jackson.
Spears's memoir The Woman in Me is released in the US and UK on 24 October.
